briefing_md:
**Build from scratch and back Haaland with the armband — no debate.**

**✅ What's strong**
This £100.0m 5-3-2 projects a tidy 63.66 XI haul. Haaland (£15.5m) is the standout captain — nailed, on pens, and rocking a monster 0.86 xGI/90. Behind him, B.Fernandes (£12.0m, 7.44 xP) is the premium engine: penalties, free-kicks and 0.68 xGI/90. The defensive base is rock-solid too, with Virgil (£6.5m, 6.33 xP) offering clean sheets, attacking threat and a soft run. No fitness flags anywhere in the pool — a clean bill of health.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building fresh, prioritise the spine: Haaland up top and Fernandes in midfield are non-negotiable. Pair Watkins (£8.0m, 5.3 xP) or João Pedro (£7.5m) alongside Haaland. For value midfielders, Enzo (£7.0m, 6.49 xP) is the pick of the differentials — penalties and free-kicks at a bargain. Cheap defensive gold? Hume (£4.5m, 4.86 xP) frees up funds without sacrificing clean-sheet upside.

**Bottom line: Load up on Haaland and Fernandes, sprinkle in Enzo and Hume for value, and let that 63-point projection do the talking.**
